personalInfo.name: Ankit Kumar
personalInfo.bio: I'm a full-stack developer with 3 years of experience specializing in React, Node.js, Flutter, and cloud infrastructure. I've optimized backend systems reducing latency by 99.6%, deployed 1,700+ production updates with zero downtime, and built applications serving 25K+ users. Currently working at Zalon, architecting microservices and e-commerce platforms.

services.title: Web Development
services.description: I've been developing full-stack web applications for several years, specializing in React, Next.js, Node.js, and cloud deployment. Built e-commerce platforms, learning platforms, and management systems.

services.title: DevOps & Cloud
services.description: Experienced in cloud infrastructure with AWS, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices architecture. Optimized systems for scalability and performance.

experience.description: Leading development of e-commerce web and mobile applications. Architected scalable microservices infrastructure on AWS with zero downtime deployments. Optimized backend performance achieving 99.6% latency reduction. Managing 14+ Node.js microservices and developed 4+ Flutter/Angular applications reaching 25K+ downloads and 10K+ monthly active users.

Led development of cross-platform invoice management app for SaaS platform trusted by MNCs. Optimized modules to achieve 100% crash-free sessions and improved user retention by 21%. Contributed to 4% monthly increase in billables.
Developed and deployed student networking platform with real-time features, article feeds, and event management. Successfully scaled to 100K downloads with strong user engagement metrics.
